# Velox House

> AI outreach platform for B2B teams, run from a single prompt. Describe your ideal customer and Velox AI plans the whole campaign: it finds and verifies matching decision-makers, researches each business, writes personalised cold emails and LinkedIn messages, and sends them every day on goal-seeking autopilot — from your own inbox, tracking every open, reply and booked meeting. Plans from £19.99/month, monthly rolling, cancel anytime. There is no free trial.

Website: https://veloxhouse.co.uk
App / sign-up: https://hub.veloxhouse.co.uk/signup
Company location: United Kingdom
Currency: GBP (£)

## What it does

- **Velox AI (campaigns from a prompt)** — Describe who you want to reach in plain English; Velox AI plans the entire campaign, finds and verifies the leads, writes the email and LinkedIn messages, and — once you approve — launches and sends across both channels on autopilot. Set a goal like "50 replies a week" and it keeps finding and sending daily until it's hit. Nothing else lets you launch outbound from a single prompt.
- **AI Discovery** — An AI query-planner expands your ideal-customer profile into dozens of targeted searches (role variants, industry codes, nearby locations), building a ranked market of hundreds of matching companies. Every prospect is AI fit-scored with a reason. Search companies or people; filter by role, seniority, department, industry, size and location. Every contact is SMTP-verified before import, so you don't pay for bounces.
- **AI Research** — Every prospect is researched automatically: business, pain points, angles and fit, so each message is personalised rather than templated.
- **AI Messaging** — Personalised cold emails, LinkedIn connection notes and follow-ups written for you. You review and send.
- **AI Copilot** — App-wide guidance: dashboard next-best-actions, "explain my numbers" analytics reads, one-click campaign autopsies, and inbox reply suggestions that read the objection and draft a response.
- **Sequences** — Multi-step email + LinkedIn follow-up that runs on a schedule from your own inbox and pauses the moment a prospect replies. Human-paced, staggered sending inside safe daily windows (Europe/London).
- **Pipeline & Inbox** — Every reply and deal stage in one place, from first touch to closed.
- **Analytics** — Live tracking of opens, replies, meetings booked and pipeline value, with an AI read of the numbers.
- **Deliverability** — SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks, a pre-send spam checker, and own-mailbox sending (Google, Microsoft 365 or any SMTP) so email comes from your own domain.

## Key facts

- AI is woven through the whole app: discovery planning, fit-scoring, per-prospect research, message writing, next-best-actions, analytics explanations, campaign autopsies and inbox reply drafting.
- Email sending is unlimited on every plan, because email is sent through the customer's own connected mailbox.
- Two metered allowances: **Contacts** (verified prospect discoveries) and **AI credits** (research and content generation).
- Growth, Scale and Agency each include one LinkedIn seat free; Starter is email-only. Extra LinkedIn seats are £19.99/month each.
- There is no free trial. You pick a plan at signup and are billed from day one. Every plan is the full product, monthly rolling, no contract — change plan or cancel anytime.

## Pricing (GBP / month, billed from day one, monthly rolling)

- **Starter** — £19.99: 300 contacts/mo, 300 AI credits, unlimited email sending, 2 mailboxes. Email-only (LinkedIn from Growth up).
- **Growth** — £49.99 (most popular): 1,000 contacts/mo, 1,000 AI credits, 1 LinkedIn seat included free, 3 seats, 5 mailboxes.
- **Scale** — £79.99 (best value per contact): 1,750 contacts/mo, 2,500 AI credits, 1 LinkedIn seat included free, 5 seats, 10 mailboxes.
- **Agency** — £179.99: 4,000 contacts/mo, 5,000 AI credits, 1 LinkedIn seat included free, 10 seats, 25 mailboxes, priority support.
- **Add-ons** — Extra contacts: +500 for £25 or +2,000 for £80. Extra LinkedIn seats (Growth and up): £19.99/mo each.

## Who it's for

Founders, B2B sales teams and agencies — especially in the UK — who want consistent, personalised cold outreach across email and LinkedIn without paying per-seat prices or sending from a shared service.
